name: squiggle
title: Squiggle
description: A hand-drawn divider: a wave, a zig-zag, a row of loops, scallops, dashes or dots, drawn to fit whatever width or height you give it. Same semantics as a separator.

a11y: Decorative by default (role="none"), like Reka UI's Separator; pass decorative={false} to expose it as a separator (with aria-orientation) between sections that really are distinct.
The drawing is aria-hidden and pointer-events-none; it is redrawn when the box is resized. Windows high contrast hides it (a decorative divider loses nothing).
Cost grows with length: about 3 KB for 420 px in a single pull; keep very long dividers (over 1200 px) to `dots` or `dashes`.
